data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features and Metrics
features.description: Highlight Artemis capabilities such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Features are clearly presented with supporting charts.
Real-time metrics are displayed using Chart.js graphs.
Charts include LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success trends.

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using an 8-stage chart.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with appropriate chart types.
Charts are interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent runs to demonstrate Artemis's effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are included in the presentation.
Data is presented in a clear and understandable format.
Charts accurately reflect recent performance data.

features.title: Utilize Existing Demo Templates
features.description: Leverage existing demo templates to create the Artemis self-demo presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Templates from specified directory are used as a base.
Presentation structure follows the format of existing demos.
Content is adapted to showcase Artemis features.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality for slides with navigation controls for user interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js library is included for visualizations.

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Create a visually impressive presentation with gradient backgrounds and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a professional gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
Overall design is cohesive and professional.

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration.
Data is clearly labeled and easy to understand.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Highlight Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Metrics are accurate and up-to-date.
Chart is visually clear and easy to interpret.
